Appraiser remarks
Vehicle inspected at the shop after a collision while turning left. The front bumper
cover is cracked across the center and the left headlamp assembly is broken, with
scuffing along the left fender and a bent support bracket behind the grille. Some of
the lower radiator support damage could have come from this impact, but it is not yet
clear whether all of it did, so that area needs a closer look before final approval.
Nothing in the shop's records shows any earlier damage to this vehicle. The invoices
show no repeated charges, and the labor hours lsited match the repair work described.
Plan: replace the bumper cover, headlamp, and bracket, refinish the left fender, and
recheck the radiator support once the old parts are off.
